archetype: Archetype 5 (Luxury) mixed with Fortress-style dense analytics
design_philosophy: Aman Resorts meets Bloomberg Terminal. A serious, premium analytics product for hospitality operators. Data-dense but beautifully crafted. Avoid generic admin panel looks and AI-slop purple gradients.

spacing_and_layout.grid_strategy: Control Room Grid (Dense). Tight gaps (gap-4 or gap-6).
spacing_and_layout.surface_treatment: Cardless or 1px subtle solid borders (`border-border`). No soft drop shadows. Use optical clarity.
spacing_and_layout.dashboard_bento: grid-cols-1 md:grid-cols-2 lg:grid-cols-4. Every pixel utilized. KPI cards span 1 column, main charts span 2.
spacing_and_layout.padding: Generous internal padding for main containers (`p-6` or `p-8`), tight padding for table cells (`px-4 py-3`).

components.charts: recharts (integrated via shadcn charts if possible, strictly adhering to custom color palette)
components.buttons: Flat, sharp or slight radius (`rounded-md`). Primary buttons use brand_accent (`bg-[#D9A05B] text-black`).
components.table: Dense. Subtle row borders (`border-b border-[#22252F]`). Hover states MUST have clear contrast (`hover:bg-[#1A1D24]`).
components.forms: Inputs use transparent backgrounds with 1px borders. Focus states must use `focus:ring-1 focus:ring-[#D9A05B]`.
components.data_testid_requirement: All interactive elements (buttons, inputs, rows, tabs) MUST include `data-testid` in kebab-case.

motion_and_interaction.hover_states: Slight background lightness bump. Chart tooltip transitions must be smooth.
motion_and_interaction.loading: Use skeleton loaders matching the dark surface color. Do NOT use spinning wheels for initial dashboard load.

empty_state_textures.usage: Use as a subtle, low-opacity (10-15%) background texture for the CSV upload empty state or login screen.

property_placeholders.usage: Use as a thumbnail in the Properties Management module.

instructions_to_main_agent: 1. Initialize the app with a dark-first theme utilizing the provided color palette in tailwind.config.js.
2. Ensure all UI components from shadcn are installed in JavaScript (.js/.jsx), NO TypeScript (.ts/.tsx).
3. Build a robust CSV Import Module: Allow file upload, parse it, show a 10-row preview, and include a 'Confirm Import' button. Include the empty state background texture.
4. Implement the Booking Source Classification logic: Map raw sources to the specified standard categories. Unmapped should default to 'Unknown'.
5. Develop the Dashboard: Build high-contrast, dense layout KPI cards (Total Reservations, Revenue, OTA vs Direct %).
6. Build Recharts components: A Bar chart for Bookings & Revenue by Source, and a Donut chart for OTA vs Direct split. Use the provided chart colors.
7. Develop the Reservations Table: Filterable and sortable. Add a dropdown menu in the 'Source' column to allow manual override of the classification.
8. Develop the Import History Log: Display file names, dates, row counts, and status in a minimal list.
9. Develop the Properties Management Module: Simple list/grid to add up to 15 property names, utilizing the placeholder images for aesthetics.
10. Ensure EVERY interactive element has a `data-testid` attribute (e.g., `data-testid="upload-csv-button"`).
11. Strictly follow the typography and 'No AI-slop' design philosophy. Keep gradients minimal and functional.
